messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Get emergency medical help if you have signs of an allergic reaction to Adderall.
These signs include hives.
These signs include difficult breathing.
These signs include swelling of your face, lips, tongue, or throat.
Serious side effects:
Adderall may cause serious side effects.
Call your doctor at once if you have:
signs of heart problems, such as chest pain, trouble breathing, or feeling like you might pass out
signs of psychosis, such as hallucinations, new behavior problems, aggression, hostility, or paranoia
signs of circulation problems, such as numbness, pain, a cold feeling, unexplained wounds, or skin color changes (pale, red, or blue appearance) in your fingers or toes
a seizure
muscle twitches (tics)
changes in your vision.
See warnings above.
Slowing of growth (height and weight) in children:
Children should have their height and weight checked often during treatment.
Your healthcare provider may stop treatment if your child is not growing or gaining weight as expected.
Serotonin syndrome:
This problem may happen when Adderall is taken with certain other medicines.
Triplet: ["healthcare provider", "may stop treatment if", "child is not growing or gaining weight as expected"]

The relation 'may stop treatment if' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject entity (usually a healthcare provider) may discontinue treatment based on the condition or situation described by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'use with caution in': The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
B. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
C. 'reduces risk of': The subject drug is used to prevent or lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.
D. 'contraindicated in': The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
E. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
